newsitem.title: USA: Watsco to buy Baker Distributing Co.
newsitem.headline: Watsco to buy Baker Distributing Co.

text.p: Watsco Inc said Thursday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Baker Distributing Co, a wholesale distributor of air conditioning, heating and refrigeration equipment and related parts and supplies.
Terms of the cash transaction were not disclosed.
Watso said the deal is expected to be accretive to earnings. It is expected to close within the next 60 days, subject to reaching a definitive pact and other conditions.
Jacksonville, Fla-based Baker is a wholly-owned subsidiary of bicycle company Trek Corp.
